body: I'll start by reading the file and checking the module declarations.

Split complete. `cli/src/login.rs` was deleted; `cli/src/login/` now contains:

| File | Lines | Content |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mod.rs` | 265 | Module docs, `LOGIN_ID`, `Login` struct, `validate`/`into_account` impl, `CnpjRequirement`, module declarations |
| `parse.rs` | 28 | `Login::parse` body (stdin/file/inline JSON) |
| `debug.rs` | 20 | `fmt::Debug` impl with secret redaction |
| `secrets.rs` | 12 | `env_secret` helper |
| `tests.rs` | 145 | Existing tests verbatim |

All files ≤300 lines; behaviour, docs, and `crate::login::{Login, LOGIN_ID}` paths preserved. `cargo check -p open-mtr-cli` passes, and `cargo clippy -p open-mtr-cli --all-targets -- -D warnings` is clean (no warnings from `login`).
